kultivator.screen.help.desa.title: Vassal villages
kultivator.screen.help.desa: From hall level 2, a vanilla village within reach of your stele can pledge to your sect. Craft a Sect Patron Plaque and place it within 24 blocks of the village bell (Overworld only, other pledged villages at least 96 blocks away, at most 1 + hall level / 3 villages). At the next nightfall stay within 48 blocks: three small waves of rogue cultivators march on the plaque and channel the Plunderer's Seal; if it never reaches 100, the village swears allegiance with loyalty 40. Loyalty (0-100) rises with finished requests, repelled raids, a posted Village Guardian (+2 a day), gifts of food (sneak-use, at most +5 a day) and hall level-ups; it falls with expired requests, sacks and a dormant hall, and at 0 the village leaves. Every 3 days the village sends tribute (crops, wool or leather, emeralds from loyalty 50, iron, rare herbs from 70, spirit stones at 100) to the storehouse, at most 3 cycles after a long absence; what does not fit waits at the village. At loyalty 50 a village sends a youth with more resolve on every arrival day of your hall. Every few days a Letter of Petition comes: a demonic beast in the fields, a bandit lair, a plague, a failed harvest or a night watch. Villages are raided now and then: defend them yourself, or post a Village Guardian (any disciple; it waits as data and appears at the plaque only while you are near). Mode Kehancuran never carves within 48 blocks of a pledged bell. Source: Perfect World ch. 3 (Stone Village makes offerings to its guardian) and ch. 27 (the guardian protects the village at night); village youths Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey ch. 1-5; mortal states under sect protection: RMJ ch. 263. The plaque, loyalty, tribute, requests and raids are game design.
